Introduction to Diamondoid Structures

Diamondoid structures are characterized by their unique molecular composition, which resembles the tetrahedral bonding of diamond. This arrangement confers exceptional strength, stability, and rigidity to the molecular framework, making this an ideal candidate for the development of molecular assemblers.
